d:
A bit rough and ready, but I wanted to translate these because I think the character concept of a slave being forced to reluctantly torment her own countrywomen is fantastic, and this rendition has a lot of personality.

Consists of three parts Kajikitetsu has made so far. I have made the editorial decision to compile these in the 1-3-2 order, because I think part 1 and 3 give more introductory information and are more similar tonally than the Princess part.

I have high quality versions for part 3 only sorry. I can't access high quality versions of the other parts. If you have the fantia versions or if they become available, please let me know and I can update this gallery to improve it!
